name: Domain Shift to Network Routing
description: Shifts the scenario from a generic scheduling/pipeline context to a store-and-forward packet networking context. By replacing "machines" and "jobs" with "servers" and "packets", and phrasing the flow-shop recurrence as channel availability prerequisites, models are deterred from recognizing the classic 2-machine flow-shop pattern and may incorrectly attempt network flow or greedy routing heuristics.
